entities.name: Hydroxy pyrrolidine substrate
observations: Benzyl carbamate-protected hydroxy pyrrolidine attached to a diethyl pyrimidine-like heteroaromatic core; the secondary alcohol is the reactive site under NaH/DMF.

entities.name: O-ethyl ether product
observations: Ethylation converts the pyrrolidine secondary alcohol from OH to OCH2CH3 while retaining the benzyl carbamate.

entities.name: NaH EtI DMF O-ethylation
observations: Sodium hydride in DMF with ethyl iodide gives O-ethylation of the secondary alcohol.
A matching record reports approximately 77% yield after 15 hours in DMF.
